levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد ابن الوليد

notes: the report is a list of routes to one book, separated by «؛»; each clause is read as written: the joins between a clause's shaykh and the next clause («جميعا») are not written in full, so the groups follow the text's clauses
the first clause «رويته عن أبي» names only the Saduq's father; the book's author هشام بن سالم is written only in the later clauses
«علي بن الحكم» and «محمد بن أبي عمير» are one level: «جميعا عن هشام بن سالم الجواليقي»
